text: OVERDOSAGE Accidental overdose with lomustine has been reported, including fatal cases. Accidental overdose has been associated with bone marrow suppression, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, anorexia, lethargy, dizziness, abnormal hepatic function, cough, and shortness of breath. No proven antidotes have been established for CeeNU overdosage. In case of overdose, appropriate supportive measures should be taken.
